name: La Clape

limits: For red wine, Grenache, Mourvèdre and Syrah together: at least 70%
For red wine, Grenache, Mourvèdre and Syrah, each: at most 70%
For red wine, Mourvèdre and Syrah together: at least 20%
For red wine, Grenache: at least 20%
For white wine, Bourboulenc: at least 40%
For white wine, Bourboulenc and Grenache Blanc together: at least 60%
For white wine, Viognier: at most 10%

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

blurb.text: A Languedoc-Roussillon appellation of six communes.
